# Quality Checks - Quick Reference Card

## Easiest Way - Use make.py Shortcuts

```bash
# Run all tests with coverage
python make.py test

# Run complete quality check
python make.py quality

# Generate and open coverage report
python make.py coverage

# Run pylint
python make.py lint

# Get pylint improvement plan
python make.py lint-fix

# Run load test
python make.py load-test

# Clean generated files
python make.py clean

# See all commands
python make.py help
```

---

## One-Command Quality Check

```bash
python tools/run_quality_checks.py
# OR
python make.py quality
```

This runs **everything** and generates `reports/quality_report.md`.

---

## Individual Commands

### Testing
```bash
# All tests with coverage
pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html:reports/coverage_html

# Unit tests only
pytest tests/unit/ -v

# Integration tests only  
pytest tests/integration/ -v -m integration

# System/E2E tests only
pytest tests/system/ -v -m system

# Performance benchmarks
pytest tests/test_performance.py --benchmark-only

# Parallel execution (faster)
pytest tests/ -n auto --cov=src

# Skip slow tests
pytest -m "not slow"

# Run specific test
pytest tests/unit/test_password_security.py::test_hash_password -vv
```

### Code Quality
```bash
# Run pylint
pylint src/

# Generate improvement plan
python tools/improve_pylint.py

# Check specific file
pylint src/main.py
```

### Load Testing
```bash
# Interactive mode
locust -f perf/load_test.py --host=http://localhost:5000
# Then open: http://localhost:8089

# Headless mode - 100 users, 60 seconds
locust -f perf/load_test.py --headless \
    --users 100 --spawn-rate 10 --run-time 60s \
    --host=http://localhost:5000 \
    --html=reports/load_test_report.html \
    --csv=reports/load_test
```

### Profiling
```python
# In your code
from tools.profiling import profile, timed, memory_tracked

@timed
def my_function():
    pass
```

---

## Targets

| Metric | Target | Command |
|--------|--------|---------|
| **Coverage** | ≥80% | `pytest tests/ --cov=src` |
| **Pylint** | ≥9.0/10 | `pylint src/` |
| **Password Hash** | <500ms | `pytest tests/test_performance.py::TestPasswordPerformance --benchmark-only` |
| **Encryption** | <50ms | `pytest tests/test_performance.py::TestEncryptionPerformance --benchmark-only` |
| **Load Test p95** | <1000ms | Load test |
| **Error Rate** | <1% | Load test |

---

## Common Workflows

### Before Committing
```bash
pytest tests/ --cov=src -q
pylint src/ --fail-under=9.0
```

### Before Pull Request
```bash
python tools/run_quality_checks.py
# Review reports/quality_report.md
```

### Weekly Review
```bash
python tools/run_quality_checks.py
python tools/improve_pylint.py
# Review both reports
```

### Before Release
```bash
# 1. Run full quality check
python tools/run_quality_checks.py

# 2. Verify targets
pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-fail-under=80
pylint src/ --fail-under=9.0

# 3. Run load test
locust -f perf/load_test.py --headless --users 100 --spawn-rate 10 --run-time 300s --host=http://localhost:5000

# 4. Review reports
cat reports/quality_report.md
```

---

## Output Files

| File | Generated By | Purpose |
|------|--------------|---------|
| `reports/quality_report.md` | `run_quality_checks.py` | Unified quality report |
| `reports/pylint_improvement_plan.md` | `improve_pylint.py` | Pylint improvement plan |
| `reports/coverage_html/index.html` | pytest | Interactive coverage report |
| `reports/coverage.xml` | pytest | Coverage for CI/CD |
| `reports/benchmark.json` | pytest-benchmark | Benchmark results |
| `reports/load_test_report.html` | locust | Load test results |
| `reports/timing.json` | profiling.py | Function timing data |
| `reports/requests.json` | profiling.py | Flask request logs |

---

## Troubleshooting

### Tests Failing
```bash
# Verbose output
pytest tests/ -vv

# Show full traceback
pytest tests/ --tb=long

# Run only failed tests
pytest --lf
```

### Coverage Too Low
```bash
# See missing lines
pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing

# HTML report for detailed view
pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-report=html:reports/coverage_html
# Open: reports/coverage_html/index.html
```

### Slow Tests
```bash
# Find slowest 10 tests
pytest tests/ --durations=10

# Skip slow tests
pytest tests/ -m "not slow"
```

### Pylint Score Low
```bash
# Get improvement plan
python tools/improve_pylint.py

# Focus on quick wins:
# 1. Add docstrings
# 2. Remove unused imports
# 3. Fix naming
```
